constraints.zhongli: Both hands CLOSED in believable polearm grips along a single straight shaft axis, never an open palm strike.
constraints.mavuika: Both hands CLOSED around one imaginary greatsword handle, wrists and hand separation stable, never palm strikes.
constraints.aratakiitto: Both hands CLOSED around one imaginary greatsword handle, coordinated two-hand raise and weighted downward cut; no open palm attack.
constraints.kamisatoayaka: Right hand CLOSED firmly around imaginary sword hilt; left hand steadies scabbard space at left waist throughout. Effective pose is drawing slash, NOT open-hand punch.
constraints.tartaglia: Both hands CLOSED around separate water-blade grip spaces, active pose is two short thrusts from low stepped stance, never open palms.
constraints.venti: Forward hand CLOSED firmly around imaginary bow handle, rear hand pinches imaginary bowstring and releases fingers only at release. Never forward open-palm blast.
constraints.arlecchino: Both black hands CLOSED around one long imaginary scythe shaft, grips remain collinear. The attack is a controlled hooking slash, not palm pushing.
constraints.clorinde: Sword hand CLOSED firmly around imaginary sword hilt, free hand held for balance; the effective pose is stepped slash, no open-palm punch.
constraints.navia: Both hands CLOSED around same umbrella shaft near chest, forearms push the OPEN umbrella mount toward opponent; canopy is a later separate layer. No open hands.
constraints.skirk: Sword hand CLOSED in a consistent reverse sword grip; narrow step and waist rotation drive a piercing thrust; off-hand balances. No palm blast.

why: 第一批绫华居合手型错误，仍标待修；后续对持武器角色逐批强化闭合握柄
